description: Put a card on the person's home screen (the web home beside your chat), or update/remove one you added. The home draws every card itself; you choose only the kind and the data, never its look. Call action='list' first to see what's already there and what the person removed. Live kinds use what this profile already has: 'calendar' (needs Google Calendar connected; settings {days: 1|3|7}), 'scheduled' (scheduled jobs), 'recent' (recent chats; {count: 3|5}), 'clock' ({zones: IANA names, up to 4}). Content kinds hold data you fetched yourself with your other tools and must name it in source: 'list' ({items: [{text, detail?, url? (https), prompt? (tapping asks you this), done?}], up to 8}), 'stats' ({stats: [{value, label, trend?: up|down|flat}], up to 3}), 'text' ({text}, up to 600 chars, plain). Content cards are snapshots: update them when the data changes. Add a card only when it will keep helping the person, give a one-line reason, and don't re-add one they removed unless they ask. You cannot change the person's own tiles.
name: home_cards

card_id.description: For update/remove: an id from action='list'.

reason.description: Why this helps, shown to the person (up to 160 chars). Required for add.

settings.description: The kind's data, as described above.

source.description: Where content-card data came from, e.g. 'Linear', 'GitHub', 'your email'.

title.description: Short card title, up to 40 chars. Required for content kinds.

user_requested.description: True only when the person asked for this card.
